assay: bulk RNA-seq (NuGEN Ovation amplified, Nextera XT) of FACS-sorted EGFP+ cardiac myofibroblasts, HiSeq2500 (S4.12.p1)
sample_inclusion: EGFP+ myofibroblasts from Postn-MCM R26eGFP hearts 4 weeks after TAC, with (Hsp47fl/fl) or without Hsp47 deletion; n = 3 per group (S2.8.p2, FIG7 C-E)
primary_estimand: Effect of myofibroblast-specific Hsp47 deletion on gene expression of EGFP+ cardiac myofibroblasts after 4 weeks of TAC pressure overload (S2.8.p2). No exercise factor: all mice received TAC; treadmill running (S4.15.p1, FIG4 G) was only a functional test of Sgcd-null dystrophic mice and was not profiled.
planned_contrasts: Hsp47-deleted vs control EGFP+ myofibroblasts after TAC (S2.8.p2; paper reports no DEG count, only Supplemental Table 1 categories)
paper_method: AltAnalyze (Kallisto TPM, empirical Bayes moderated t-test) (S4.12.p1; GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO data_processing (paper S4.12.p1 states no cutoff): moderated t p<0.05 non-adjusted with fold>2

paper_results: Up: Chad, Aspn, Tnmd, Fmod, Sdc4, Tgfb2, Furin, Cthrc1, Lox, Mmp3, Postn; down: Col1a1, Col3a1, Fn1, Fbn1, Adam12 (S2.8.p3, qPCR-confirmed). No DEG count reported.
